name: Paid Ads Auditor
cadence: Weekly, plus an hourly Google Ads monitor once the API read is on (paused until then)

sources.label: Google Ads API read
sources.why: the Google Ads API read is not on yet (#3794): Mimi turns on Google Ads API access for GCP project ihg-sales-brain and adds the Brain's service account to each Google Ads account as Read only; then ADS_API_LIVE is switched on

does: Weekly audit of Google ads: wasted search terms, wrong landing pages, our venues bidding against each other
Watches Google Ads every hour: spend with no conversions, impressions dropping to zero, disapproved ads, limited or paused campaigns, landing pages that 404, two venues on one search term

traits.cant: Change a campaign, budget, bid or ad
traits.instead: Writes the change for the agency (K&M) to make

needs: Mimi: turn on Google Ads API access for GCP project ihg-sales-brain and add the Brain's service account to each Google Ads account as Read only (#3794)
